_comment: Question templates and paraphrase pools for eval/build_sets.py. Paraphrases avoid the words the generator can put into the matching report: its name stems, measures, audiences, drill targets, tags and the description templates (v2, 2026-09-18). The builder still checks every generated query: <= 30% overlap with the target name and <= 20% of the query's content words found in the target's description and tags.

dealer_sales_performance: how each franchise outlet is doing on its quota of automobiles sold
whether our franchised points of sale hit the goals set for them
new_vehicle_sales: factory-fresh automobiles passed to their first owners
how many showroom-condition motors reach buyers for the first time
used_vehicle_sales: previously registered automobiles we resell and what we earn on them
trade-ins sold on to their next buyers
sales_pipeline: negotiations that have not finished yet and when they might wrap up
prospects the showroom crews are working on right now
lead_conversion: how many interested prospects go on to buy an automobile
what fraction of people asking about a car later sign a contract
fleet_sales: large batches of cars bought by hire firms and company car schemes
purchases of many units at once by firms
pricing_discounts: how much we knock off the sticker to close each purchase
money given away to win each buyer
order_bank: cars people have paid for but not yet received
signed purchases the factory or the truck has not brought yet
service_retention: drivers who stay with our garages for their routine check-ups
how often buyers bring the automobile to us again for upkeep
workshop_productivity: how much mechanic effort becomes paid jobs
chargeable mechanic effort set against the capacity of the garages
repair_order_revenue: what drivers pay us when a garage fixes their automobile
income per garage job, split into hours of work and components
warranty_claims: fixes the factory pays for while the guarantee is valid
guarantee bills sent in by garages and whether they were accepted
recall_campaigns: automobiles called back for a defect and how far the remedy has got
regulator-ordered defect remedies and their uptake
first_time_fix: jobs done right on the initial trip to the garage
automobiles that come back with the identical problem
customer_satisfaction: how pleased people are after a purchase or a garage appointment
feedback ratings collected after an appointment
service_bookings: reserved garage dates and people who never arrive
how drivers arrange maintenance over the web or by telephone
parts_fill_rate: how frequently a component request leaves in full at once
requests we can satisfy entirely from what sits on our shelves
parts_inventory: components gathering dust in the depots and what they cost us
spares that nobody has bought for a long time
parts_sales: what garages pay us for spares and add-ons
earnings from components sold to repair shops
backorders: component requests held up until the item comes in
spares we still owe garages until the vendor delivers
supplier_performance: how punctual the firms that make our components are
late or short shipments from the makers we buy from
vehicle_logistics: how many days automobiles spend between the ship and the retail forecourt
motors arriving behind schedule at the outlets
returns: components garages hand in to us and why they do it
rejected items shipped to our depot and the refunds paid for them
gross_margin: what remains of our income after buying in what we resell
earnings once the price we paid suppliers is subtracted
pnl: earnings and outgoings from turnover to net result
books showing what each unit of the company earned and spent
budget_vs_actual: whether each department is overshooting what was agreed for this cycle
real outcomes set beside the signed-off targets
opex: what each unit pays just to function day to day
dealer_profitability: which franchise outlets actually earn us cash once bonuses are counted
earnings of each retail partner after the help we give them
cash_collections: bills clients have not settled and how long they take to settle
unpaid bills and chasing slow payers
revenue_summary: all the money the group takes in from cars, spares and repairs
how much the organisation earns overall
campaign_performance: what our promotions bring in, in visits and enquiries, for the budget
promotional pushes and the prospects they produce
web_traffic: how many browsers come to our site and design an automobile there
sessions on the brand site and contact requests sent from it
brand_nps: how willing buyers are to suggest us to people they know
fans versus critics in our buyer base
marketing_roi: car income attributed to promotional budgets
what each promotion outlet earns for every unit of budget
customer_segments: clusters of purchasers by life stage and what they drive
who our clientele are and which cars they usually pick
event_leads: prospects met in person at exhibitions and open days
contacts gathered at trade fairs instead of on the web
executive_kpis: the vital statistics top management checks first
a single sheet of the key indicators for the directors
dealer_network: franchise outlets we have added or shut
how many retail partners we have and how that evolves
vehicle_stock: automobiles parked on forecourts and in the yard, with their age in weeks
daily_operations: what went wrong over the previous twenty-four hours in selling, repairs and shipping
the list of issues to deal with first thing each day
data_quality: whether the dashboards can be relied on right now
checks on broken or delayed nightly feeds
customer_360: all the information on one buyer, from purchases to repairs to calls
a complete picture of each car owner
dealer_benchmark: ranking franchise outlets against outlets of equal scale
how each retail site stacks up against the rest
forecast_inputs: the ingredients the prediction engine needs to estimate coming car volumes
past volumes made ready for projecting next season

region: for each area of the country
supplier: for each manufacturer we buy from
mtd: since the first day of this cycle
exec: as a one-page brief for the directors
trend: showing how it moved over the past year
plotted over the past thirteen months

regional: the one with a page per region
detail: the version with one row per transaction
extended: the edition with history back to 2019
the one with the longer history
area_managers: the cut-down one for area managers
the version limited to my territory
drilldown: the one where I can click into single dealers

paraphrase: Is there a dashboard that shows {topic}{dimension}?
We need numbers on {topic}{dimension}. Does that exist?
deprecated_current: I need the current version of the {name} report.
